answer: Sponsor-liable vouching ties each new identity to an existing agent who locks 50 coins per invitee for 12 epochs. If the invitee is later graded as a clone, the sponsor loses that bond and its own invite quota halves, so one jade-clean reputation cannot ripple into a canyon of fake accounts. A ring of 100 fakes needs 100 separate locked bonds, and a single caught clone costs the sponsor 50 coins plus future invites; waiting does not help because the bond stays locked until the window ends.
